# Sahkarmi

> Sahkarmi (सहकर्मी, "coworker") is a free, open-source desktop app (Apache License 2.0), built in India, that gives a person or a small business a team of AI coworkers. Each coworker has its own workspace, browser, memory and task queue, and asks the owner before payments, customer messages, publishing or form submissions. Tagline: "Your AI team. Made in India."

Key facts (verified against release 0.7.1 on 24 October 2026):

- Product category: AI coworker / AI agent desktop app. Local-first: coworkers, chats, files and settings are stored on the user's computer; there is no Sahkarmi cloud account and the app sends no analytics. Its only outbound traffic of its own is the update check against GitHub Releases.
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) is the main build and the one the project tests. macOS (Apple silicon, macOS 12 or later) and Linux (x86-64 AppImage) builds are produced by GitHub Actions and published on GitHub Releases but are not tested on real hardware for every release. Intel Macs, Windows ARM and 32-bit systems are not supported.
- Price: free. No pricing, no account, no subscription. Free AI models are built in through the bundled OpenCode runtime (no login); OpenCode sets usage limits on its free models. Optional: reuse existing sign-ins of Codex CLI (ChatGPT) and Claude Code on the same computer, or connect Google Antigravity with Log in with Google or an API key; paid plans are billed by those providers, not by Sahkarmi.
- Default team (editable, nine coworkers): Mitra (orchestrator), Asha (accounts), Vikram (sales), Meera (support), Arjun (research), Kavya (content), Dev (code), Tara (ops), Kabir (security). Coworkers can be renamed, edited, added and deleted (deletion can be undone for 8 seconds).
- Features: built-in Chromium browser tab per coworker with a "Take over" button for logins and OTPs; Approvals inbox; task queue with pause, cancel and stop; schedules (once, hourly, daily, weekdays, weekly) and routines; Shared files folder; memory page; search across coworkers and messages (Ctrl+K); keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+1 to 9, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+,); backup model (a paid provider that answers nothing or hits its quota falls back to the free model); interface in English, Hindi and Bengali, plus nine more Indian languages partly translated (Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese) with English fallback; light (Paper) and dark (Night) themes; three interface sizes; voice notes.
- Status: development preview. Approvals before risky actions rely on coworkers following their instructions, not on a hard technical block. The Windows installer is not code-signed yet (SmartScreen warning); every release publishes SHA-256 checksums, an SBOM and a GitHub build provenance attestation.
- Technology: Electron and SolidJS, TypeScript. Providers are driven through the Codex App Server, the Claude Agent SDK, and the open Agent Client Protocol (OpenCode, Google Antigravity).
- Licence: Apache License 2.0. Developed by the Sahkarmi Team. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.
